transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. As you know, the attorney general's office has requested a written response regarding our auto-renewal cancellation process. Before I can give final approval to our response, our routine pre-filing review requires input from both consumer regulatory counsel and customer operations. I need each of you to report any relevant legal and operational information so we can accurately describe the company's position and any corrective measures we plan to take. Let's start with what we know and what we need to gather.

transcript.text: I need to share something important from a call I had with the attorney general's staff after the response draft was circulated. They indicated that an acceptable resolution would require three specific things: a one-click cancellation process, a confirmation sent within 24 hours, and an express no-admission-of-liability provision. I captured this in my call notes but haven't yet incorporated it into the draft. This directly affects what corrective measures we should be describing in our response.
